meta.name: Project Worlds Preference Schema
meta.description: User comfort preferences. No value combination violates the accessibility floor.

motion.description: off = no nonessential animation, no ambient/idle movement, no decorative pose transitions. reduced (default) = no continuous/ambient animation; instant state/pose changes allowed. subtle = opt-in; transitions <=300ms, ambient movement <=2px where allowed, no pulse/spin/shake/flash. OS prefers-reduced-motion always overrides and suppresses subtle animation. Motion is never required to understand or operate the product.

contrast.description: comfortable = low-glare WCAG AA. high = added borders, brighter accents. No value drops below AA.

text_scale.description: Multiplier on base sizes. Minimum effective body size: 14px * text_scale. Never prevents browser zoom.

density.description: compact tightens spacing but never reduces hit areas below 44px. relaxed increases spacing.

targets.description: standard = 44px minimum hit area. large = 56px minimum hit area.

tone.description: Tone register of the ONE Worlds voice across chat + attention surfaces (TRUE-NORTH § Voice, owner ruling 2026-09-22). A phrasing/comfort preference, not an accessibility one: no register may lower the accessibility floor or the honesty floor — facts, statuses, and uncertainty stay exact in every tone, and degraded/model-off states are labeled honestly in whichever tone is active.

personality_pack.description: Optional personality pack (TRUE-NORTH § Voice). residents (default since 2026-09-25) = the character-crew / two-voice personalities (canon: docs/CHARACTER-HANDBOOK.md, docs/COMPANION-CANON.md) layered as flavor on top of the same truth rules. off = the one Worlds voice. No value removes the honesty floor or any accessibility requirement.

constraints: A lower layer may never violate a requirement above it.
OS prefers-reduced-motion overrides the motion preference.
No combination of values violates WCAG 2.1 AA.
